finalText:
The open RMAs are mostly worked through, but two things are unresolved. The customer who wrote about RMA-807 got no reply, which the handbook requires. And the count of closed RMAs in the worker's report doesn't match its own table.

**Closed: refunded, restocked by warehouse grade**

| RMA | Refund | Basis | Restocked |
|---|---|---|---|
| 801 | $109.65 card | 15% change-of-mind fee; requested 07-08, before PU-21 removed the fee | P-KEY ×1 sellable |
| 802 | $159.00 card | No fee under PU-21 | P-HDP ×1 sellable |
| 803 | $279.65 store credit | 15% fee; requested 41 days after shipping. Customer became gold on 07-15, after the request, so PU-18's 45-day window doesn't apply | P-MON ×1 sellable |
| 804 | $279.65 store credit | 15% fee; 41 days, standard tier | P-MON ×1 sellable |
| 805 | $55.20 card | 20% fee under PU-15 (requested 06-25) | P-HUB ×1 sellable |
| 806 | $73.50 card | Defective, no fee; amount actually paid after the MOUSE25 discount | P-MOU ×2 damaged |
| 810 | $99.00 card | Defective; $129.00 paid less $30.00 already refunded | P-KEY ×1 damaged |
| 811 | $49.00 card | Damaged in transit, no fee | P-MOU ×1 sellable |
| 812 | $219.00 card | Defective, 28 days after shipping | P-DOC ×1 damaged |
| 813 | $109.65 card | 15% fee; requested on day 30, still inside the window | P-KEY ×1 sellable |
| 814 | $318.00 card | No fee under PU-21; both units received | P-HDP ×2 sellable |
| 815 | $109.65 card | 15% fee (requested 07-09, before PU-21); 38 days, inside the 45-day platinum window | P-KEY ×1 sellable |

For RMA-803 and RMA-804, the store credit was recorded against the order and also added to each customer's balance. C-803 now has $279.65 and C-804 has $291.65.

**Not closed**
- **RMA-809 (open):** 2 of the 3 cables have arrived. $38.00 was refunded to card with no fee under PU-21. One unit went back as sellable and one as damaged. The third unit still needs settling when it arrives.
- **RMA-808 (investigation INV-1 opened):** the return covers a monitor (P-MON), but the warehouse received a cable (P-CAB). Nothing was refunded or restocked.
- **RMA-807 (open):** nothing has been received. The customer says tracking showed delivery on 07-23 and wants a refund now. Under the rules nothing is refunded until the warehouse logs the parcel. It may be worth asking the warehouse whether it has arrived.
- **RMA-816 (open):** nothing has been received yet.

**Gaps and inconsistencies in the report**
1. **No reply on RMA-807:** the worker sent no customer emails, saying the returns rules don't call for them. But the handbook says every message worked must get a reply (`reply_to_message`). The RMA-807 customer still needs one explaining that no refund can be issued until the warehouse receives the parcel. The report also doesn't say whether that message came from the email address on the account.
2. **Count mismatch:** the report says 13 RMAs were settled and closed, but its table lists 12. With RMA-809, 808, 807 and 816, that accounts for all 16. So 12 closed appears correct, but the report contradicts itself.
3. **Date mismatch:** the tools gave today's date as 2026-07-25, while the environment says 2026-10-12. The worker says this changed no outcome because every rule depends on request and ship dates. I can't check that independently.
